name: The Groove People
description: The Groove People is an event offering a new concept and energy, focused on music without excesses or barriers. It aims to create a unified vibe where everyone shares the same energy and language through music.
longDescription:
The Groove People is an event organised by Too Much Information, taking place in Porto, Portugal. It is scheduled for Saturday, December 5, 2026, starting at 11:30 PM and continuing until 6:00 AM.

The event promotes a new concept and energy, described as more exclusive and limited, without VIP areas or filters. The focus is on a shared musical experience, where all attendees are part of the same vibe and energy.

Tickets are available for €7.00. Attendees can secure their tickets now and have the option to resell them safely through the Shotgun app if their plans change.
